# Hotstar

> Streaming platform for movies, TV shows, live sports, and original entertainment across multiple Indian languages.

Hotstar offers subscription and ad-supported streaming with a large catalog of films, series, kids content, and live events. The platform is available on web, mobile, and connected TV, with dedicated areas for sports, premium entertainment, and account management.

## Main Platform
- [Home](https://www.hotstar.com/in): Main streaming homepage featuring latest releases, trending titles, and personalized recommendations.
- [Subscribe](https://www.hotstar.com/in/subscribe/get-started): Subscription signup flow for choosing a plan and starting paid access.
- [My Account](https://www.hotstar.com/in/my-account): Account area for managing profile, subscription, and billing details.
- [Watchlist](https://www.hotstar.com/in/watchlist): Saved titles list for quick access to movies, shows, and sports.
- [Search](https://www.hotstar.com/in/explore): Discovery and browsing area for finding content across categories.

## Movies & Shows
- [Movies](https://www.hotstar.com/in/movies): Browse the movie catalog across genres, languages, and featured collections.
- [TV Shows](https://www.hotstar.com/in/tv): Browse series, drama, comedy, reality, and other television programming.
- [Latest Releases](https://www.hotstar.com/in): Homepage section highlighting newly added films, episodes, and specials.
- [Trending Now](https://www.hotstar.com/in): Homepage section surfacing currently popular titles and live content.
- [Hotstar Specials](https://www.hotstar.com/in/hotstar-specials): Original series and exclusive programming produced for the platform.

## Sports
- [Sports](https://www.hotstar.com/in/sports): Main sports hub for live matches, highlights, replays, and sports programming.
- [Cricket](https://www.hotstar.com/in/sports/cricket): Cricket coverage including live streams, highlights, and related shows.
- [Football](https://www.hotstar.com/in/sports/football): Football matches, clips, highlights, and tournament coverage.
- [Tennis](https://www.hotstar.com/in/sports/tennis): Tennis events, match highlights, and related sports content.
- [Formula 1](https://www.hotstar.com/in/sports/formula1): Formula 1 races, highlights, and motorsport coverage.

## Languages & Regional Content
- [Hindi](https://www.hotstar.com/in/languages/hindi): Hindi-language movies, shows, and featured entertainment collections.
- [English](https://www.hotstar.com/in/languages/english): English-language films, series, and international programming.
- [Tamil](https://www.hotstar.com/in/languages/tamil): Tamil-language catalog including movies, serials, and originals.
- [Telugu](https://www.hotstar.com/in/languages/telugu): Telugu-language entertainment and regional content collections.
- [Malayalam](https://www.hotstar.com/in/languages/malayalam): Malayalam-language movies, shows, and curated selections.
- [Kannada](https://www.hotstar.com/in/languages/kannada): Kannada-language streaming catalog and featured titles.
- [Bengali](https://www.hotstar.com/in/languages/bengali): Bengali-language films, series, and regional programming.

## Help & Support
- [Help Center](https://help.hotstar.com/): Support portal for account, billing, playback, and device questions.
- [Subscription & Billing Help](https://help.hotstar.com/in/en/support/solutions/folders/68000383414): Help articles for plans, payments, renewals, and subscription issues.
- [Watching Hotstar](https://help.hotstar.com/in/en/support/solutions/folders/68000383415): Support content for streaming, playback, and viewing experience problems.
- [Supported Devices](https://help.hotstar.com/in/en/support/solutions/folders/68000383416): Device compatibility and setup guidance for phones, TVs, and browsers.
- [Account Settings Help](https://help.hotstar.com/in/en/support/solutions/folders/68000383413): Articles covering login, profiles, password, and account management.

## Legal & Policies
- [Terms of Use](https://www.hotstar.com/in/terms-of-use): Terms governing access to Hotstar services, content, and subscriptions.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.hotstar.com/in/privacy-policy): Policy describing collection, use, and protection of personal information.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.hotstar.com/in/cookie-policy): Information about cookies, tracking technologies, and user choices.
- [Grievance Redressal](https://www.hotstar.com/in/grievance-redressal-mechanism): Process for complaints, notices, and grievance handling.
- [Content Complaints](https://www.hotstar.com/in/content-complaints): Information for submitting complaints related to hosted content.

## Apps & Devices
- [Android App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.startv.hotstar): Android application for streaming Hotstar content on mobile devices.
- [iOS App](https://apps.apple.com/in/app/hotstar/id934459219): iPhone and iPad app for watching movies, shows, and sports.
- [Connected TV Support](https://help.hotstar.com/in/en/support/solutions/folders/68000383416): Setup and troubleshooting guidance for smart TVs and streaming devices.
- [Web Player](https://www.hotstar.com/in): Browser-based streaming experience for desktop and laptop users.

## Advertising
- [Hotstar Ads](https://ads.hotstar.com/): Advertising portal for brands running campaigns on the Hotstar platform.
- [About Hotstar Ads](https://ads.hotstar.com/about-us/): Overview of Hotstar advertising offerings and platform reach.
- [Campaign Planning](https://ads.hotstar.com/campaign-planning/): Information on campaign setup, targeting, and ad planning options.
- [Brand Measurement](https://ads.hotstar.com/brand-measurement/): Measurement solutions for evaluating campaign effectiveness and brand lift.
